capture.comparison: Processing bypassed versus FSR 3.1.6 Native AA; MSAA/FXAA/FG off
capture.note: Matched stationary external view; sequential captures. No sharpening, denoising, frame generation or image enhancement added. Not a performance benchmark or general ghosting-fix demonstration.

scenes.title:
A clearer setup.
A better starting point.
lines: A short guide to your next flight
scenes.narration: Welcome to F S R for X Plane. This community preview brings temporal anti aliasing, upscaling, and clearer setup controls into one launcher.

scenes.title: See the same scene, two ways.
scenes.narration: These fresh simulator captures show processing off, then F S R three Native A A active, at ten eighty p. Compare the wing and runway edges. This is one example, not a performance benchmark.

scenes.title: Start with a preset.
scenes.narration: Start with a preset. Native A A keeps the full internal resolution. Quality reconstructs a larger output from fewer pixels. F S R four remains an experimental, hardware dependent option.

scenes.title:
1440p in.
4K out.
lines: FXAA Off  /  start with MSAA Off
scenes.narration: For four K Quality, select four K output with fourteen forty p input. A fourteen forty p output setting stays fourteen forty p. Leave F X A A off, and start with M S A A off.

scenes.title:
Saved choices.
Visible confirmation.
lines: Help explains settings and their intended use
FSR ACTIVE requires recent renderer activity
scenes.narration: Your selections are remembered. Help explains each setting and its intended use. Check the live status for recent F S R activity; launching the simulator alone does not confirm reconstruction.

scenes.title: Keep expectations clear.
lines: Clouds, props and moving objects can still ghost
Linux: FSR 3.1 preview  /  Mac: diagnostics only
scenes.narration: The cockpit screen option supports selected displays. Clouds, propellers, and moving objects can still ghost. Built in frame generation is suspended. Linux has a separate preview; Mac currently provides diagnostics only.

scenes.narration: Each update can introduce its changes here. Skip at any time, turn future videos off, or replay from What's New. Choose your profile, check the status, and enjoy your flight.
